cat > /workspace/tmp/t2/perf4.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, os, time, tempfile, resource, random
MAIN="/app/submission/main.py"
def limited(): resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(512*1024*1024,)*2)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/workspace/tmp"); rnd=random.Random(7)
rules=[]
for i in range(512):   # 512*32 = 16384 positions (max)
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":i%65536,"priority":i,"ranges":[[rnd.randint(-2048,0),rnd.randint(0,2048)]]*32})
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print("prog bytes", len(p.stdout))
prog=os.path.join(d,"a.json"); open(prog,"wb").write(p.stdout)
pr=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN,"stream",prog],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,cwd=d,preexec_fn=limited)
t0=time.time()
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":i,"time":0} for i in range(4096)]
for r in reqs:
    pr.stdin.write(json.dumps(r).encode()+b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush(); pr.stdout.readline()
n=0
for blk in range(100):   # 4096 flows * 100 packets = 409600 packets, chunk size 1024
    pk=[{"flow":(blk*1024+j)%4096,"time":blk,"source":j%2,"length":1+(j*13)%2048} for j in range(1024)]
    pr.stdin.write(json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}).encode()+b"\n"); pr.stdin.flush(); pr.stdout.readline()
    n+=1024
pr.stdin.write(b'{"op":"checkpoint"}\n'); pr.stdin.flush(); line=pr.stdout.readline()
pr.stdin.close(); pr.wait()
print("packets",n,"time",round(time.time()-t0,1),"peak RSS MB",resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024)
print("ckpt bytes", len(line))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp/t2 && timeout 300 python3 perf4.py
